verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a consumer app that generates one-time 2FA codes (TOTP/HOTP) for sites and apps. Issuing scoped API credentials is done by the service or IAM platform that owns the API, not by an OTP generator, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it exposes an API or issues credentials of any kind.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
